title:
three builds,
one question
lessonsBefore: Let people carry it with you.
No style is right every time.
Give everyone a part that's theirs.
Hear it from the people you led.
lines: Before Six Flights, Kate built the MVP of our game, Team Quest.
It tracked just two meters, rapport and energy, and gave you a leadership chart at the end.
That's the question we built Six Flights around.
We wanted to push that idea even further, which led to Asterwind.
In one story, you decide to stay up until 3 a.m. fixing something together.
You then have to break the news to the person it affects, building the sentence yourself,
Team Quest made you budget, and Six Flights showed who carried what,
and Asterwind puts you right in front of the person living with your choice.
Underneath all three, we ask the same exact question:

big.text:
What is it like
to be led by you?
